lessons.title: Keeping the Language
lessons.context: A family that speaks Tatar at home.

paragraphs.tt: Минем әти-әнием өйдә гел татарча сөйләшә.
paragraphs.en: My parents always speak Tatar at home.

paragraphs.tt: Алар балаларының туган телне онытуын теләмиләр.
paragraphs.en: They don't want their children to forget their native language.

paragraphs.tt: Шуңа күрә кичләрен без бергә татар китаплары укыйбыз.
paragraphs.en: That's why we read Tatar books together in the evenings.

paragraphs.tt: Энем башта укырга теләмәде, ләкин хәзер ул әкиятләрне бик ярата.
paragraphs.en: At first my younger brother didn't want to read, but now he loves the fairy tales.

paragraphs.tt: Мин дә үз балаларыма татар телен өйрәтергә ниятлим.
paragraphs.en: I also intend to teach my own children Tatar.

questions.question: What language do the parents speak at home?
What are the parents afraid of?
options: That the children will forget Tatar
That the children read too much

questions.question: How did the brother feel about reading at first?
What does the narrator plan to do?
options: Teach Tatar to their own children

lessons.title: A New Profession
lessons.context: Leaving a bank job to become an artist.

paragraphs.tt: Апам озак еллар банкта эшләде.
paragraphs.en: My older sister worked at a bank for many years.

paragraphs.tt: Ләкин аның гел рәсем ясыйсы килә иде.
paragraphs.en: But she always wanted to paint.

paragraphs.tt: Былтыр ул эшен ташлап, рәссамлык курсларына йөри башлады.
paragraphs.en: Last year she quit her job and started going to art classes.

paragraphs.tt: Башта гаиләбез борчылды, чөнки акча аз иде.
paragraphs.en: At first our family worried, because there was little money.

paragraphs.tt: Хәзер аның рәсемнәре күргәзмәләрдә күрсәтелә, һәм ул бик бәхетле.
paragraphs.en: Now her paintings are shown at exhibitions, and she is very happy.

questions.question: Where did the sister work?
What did she always want to do?
Why was the family worried?
Where are her paintings shown now?

lessons.title: On the Train
lessons.context: A night of stories with a stranger.

paragraphs.tt: Мин Казаннан Мәскәүгә поездда бара идем.
paragraphs.en: I was travelling by train from Kazan to Moscow.

paragraphs.tt: Купеда минем белән бер карт кеше утыра иде.
paragraphs.en: An old man was sitting in the compartment with me.

paragraphs.tt: Ул яшь чагында бөтен илне гизеп чыккан икән.
paragraphs.en: It turned out that as a young man he had travelled all over the country.

paragraphs.tt: Ул миңа үзенең сәяхәтләре турында төне буе сөйләде.
paragraphs.en: He told me about his travels all night long.

paragraphs.tt: Мәскәүгә килеп җиткәнче без бер дә йокламадык.
paragraphs.en: We didn't sleep at all until we reached Moscow.

questions.question: Where was the narrator going?
Who shared the compartment?
What had the old man done when young?
How much did they sleep?

lessons.title: The School Concert
lessons.context: Stage fright and a happy ending.

paragraphs.tt: Безнең мәктәптә һәр ел яз көне зур концерт үткәрелә.
paragraphs.en: Every year in spring a big concert is held at our school.

paragraphs.tt: Быел мин дә анда җырларга булдым.
paragraphs.en: This year I decided to sing in it too.

paragraphs.tt: Концерт алдыннан мин бик дулкынландым, тавышым калтырый иде.
paragraphs.en: Before the concert I was very nervous, and my voice was shaking.

paragraphs.tt: Ләкин сәхнәгә чыккач, барысы да онытылды.
paragraphs.en: But once I was on stage, everything was forgotten.

paragraphs.tt: Тамашачылар озак кул чапты, ә әнием хәтта елап җибәрде.
paragraphs.en: The audience clapped for a long time, and my mother even burst into tears.

questions.question: When is the concert held?
What did the narrator decide to do?
How did the narrator feel before the concert?
What did the mother do?

paragraphs.tt: Безнең яңа күршеләр узган айда күченеп килделәр.
paragraphs.en: Our new neighbours moved in last month.

paragraphs.tt: Алар Үзбәкстаннан килгән гаилә, өч балалары бар.
paragraphs.en: They are a family from Uzbekistan with three children.

paragraphs.tt: Беренче көнне үк алар безне чәйгә чакырдылар.
paragraphs.en: On the very first day they invited us for tea.

paragraphs.tt: Алар безне тәмле пылау белән сыйладылар, ә без аларга чәкчәк алып бардык.
paragraphs.en: They treated us to delicious pilaf, and we brought them chak-chak.

paragraphs.tt: Хәзер без бик яхшы дуслар, һәм балаларыбыз бергә уйный.
paragraphs.en: Now we are very good friends, and our children play together.

questions.question: Where is the new family from?
How many children do they have?
What did the neighbours serve?
What are the two families now?

lessons.title: Living Healthily
lessons.context: Small habits that make a difference.

paragraphs.tt: Соңгы вакытта мин үз сәламәтлегем турында күбрәк уйлый башладым.
paragraphs.en: Lately I've started thinking more about my health.

paragraphs.tt: Хәзер мин иртән торгач, бер стакан су эчәм һәм күнегүләр ясыйм.
paragraphs.en: Now after I get up in the morning, I drink a glass of water and do exercises.

paragraphs.tt: Эшкә автобуста түгел, җәяү барам.
paragraphs.en: I walk to work instead of taking the bus.

paragraphs.tt: Кичен йокларга ятканчы телефонга карамаска тырышам.
paragraphs.en: In the evening I try not to look at my phone before going to bed.

paragraphs.tt: Үземне күпкә яхшырак хис итәм, һәм бу мине шатландыра.
paragraphs.en: I feel much better, and that makes me happy.

questions.question: What does the narrator do after getting up?
How does the narrator get to work?
What does the narrator avoid before bed?
How does the narrator feel now?

lessons.title: Grandmother's Letters
lessons.context: A box of letters from the war years.

paragraphs.tt: Чормада без иске бер тартма таптык.
paragraphs.en: We found an old box in the attic.

paragraphs.tt: Анда әбиемнең яшь чагында язган хатлары саклана иде.
paragraphs.en: Inside were letters my grandmother had written when she was young.

paragraphs.tt: Ул аларны сугыш вакытында фронттагы бабама язган.
paragraphs.en: She wrote them to my grandfather at the front during the war.

paragraphs.tt: Хатларны укыганда мин аларның бер-берсен никадәр яратуын аңладым.
paragraphs.en: Reading the letters, I understood how much they loved each other.

paragraphs.tt: Без бу хатларны киләчәк буыннар өчен сакларга булдык.
paragraphs.en: We decided to keep these letters for future generations.

questions.question: Where was the box found?
Who wrote the letters?
When were they written?
What will the family do with them?

lessons.title: Lost in the Forest
lessons.context: A mushroom hunt that went wrong.

paragraphs.tt: Узган көз без дусларым белән урманга гөмбә җыярга бардык.
paragraphs.en: Last autumn my friends and I went to the forest to pick mushrooms.

paragraphs.tt: Без гөмбә эзләп, урманның эченә үк кереп киттек.
paragraphs.en: Looking for mushrooms, we went deep into the forest.

paragraphs.tt: Кинәт без юлны югалтканыбызны аңладык.
paragraphs.en: Suddenly we realised we had lost the path.

paragraphs.tt: Телефоннар эшләмәгәнгә күрә, без кояшка карап юнәлешне таптык.
paragraphs.en: Because our phones weren't working, we found our way by looking at the sun.

paragraphs.tt: Караңгы төшкәнче без авылга кайтып җиттек һәм бик шатландык.
paragraphs.en: We got back to the village before dark and were very relieved.

questions.question: Why did they go to the forest?
What did they suddenly realise?
How did they find their way?
When did they get back?

lessons.title: Studying Abroad
lessons.context: A younger sister starts university in Turkey.

paragraphs.tt: Сеңлем быел Төркиягә укырга китте.
paragraphs.en: My younger sister went to study in Turkey this year.

paragraphs.tt: Төрек теле татар теленә охшаш булганга күрә, ул аны тиз өйрәнде.
paragraphs.en: Because Turkish is similar to Tatar, she learned it quickly.

paragraphs.tt: Башта аңа гаиләсез яшәү авыр булды.
paragraphs.en: At first it was hard for her to live without her family.

paragraphs.tt: Хәзер ул яңа дуслар тапты һәм университетта яхшы укый.
paragraphs.en: Now she has made new friends and is doing well at university.

paragraphs.tt: Без аның белән атна саен видео аша сөйләшәбез.
paragraphs.en: We talk with her by video every week.

questions.question: Where did the sister go to study?
Why did she learn Turkish quickly?
What was hard at first?
How often do they talk?

paragraphs.tt: Ураза бәйрәме алдыннан бөтен гаилә җыела.
paragraphs.en: Before Eid the whole family gathers.

paragraphs.tt: Әниләр һәм әбиләр бер көн алдан ук пешерә башлыйлар.
paragraphs.en: Mothers and grandmothers start cooking a day in advance.

paragraphs.tt: Табында бәлеш, өчпочмак, чәкчәк һәм тагын күп тәмле ризыклар була.
paragraphs.en: On the table there are pies, öçpoçmaq, chak-chak and many other tasty dishes.

paragraphs.tt: Иртән ирләр мәчеткә баралар, аннары туганнарга кунакка йөриләр.
paragraphs.en: In the morning the men go to the mosque, and then they visit relatives.

paragraphs.tt: Бу көнне һәркем бер-берсен котлый һәм бүләкләр бирә.
paragraphs.en: On this day everyone congratulates one another and gives presents.

questions.question: Which holiday is described?
When does the cooking start?
Where do the men go in the morning?
What does everyone do on this day?
